label: SI cross-asset 20-day daily momentum overnight (Friday longs) true 5R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `EURJPY 20-day daily momentum overnight (Friday longs)`. Daily time-series momentum using a 20-day close-to-close lookback. Filter: long signals on weekday 4. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection.
verificationSummary: Cross-asset strict PF 2.29 over 131 trades; average planned RR 5.01, min planned RR 4.79; bootstrap p05 1.47, block-bootstrap p05 1.58, annual pass rate 100%.
